events.description: A list of event objects; each object represents a single event.

name.description: Short, human-readable name of the event.

link.description: Link to more information about the event.

summary.description: Concise summary or abstract describing the event.

keywords.description: List of keywords or tags related to the event.

date.description: The calendar date of the event in MM-DD format (month-day).

time.description: The local time of the event as HHMM where HH is 24-hour (for example 0930, 2359).

location.description: Location or address of the event as a single string.
